posts.title: Why we made Prompt Pulse and the ChatGPT Visibility Tracker free
posts.metaTitle: Why our AI visibility tools are free | A founder note from Eason Wang
posts.description: A note from SolCrys co-founder Eason Wang on why we made two tools — the free ChatGPT Visibility Tracker and Prompt Pulse — free for any brand: seeing where you stand in AI search shouldn't be locked behind enterprise pricing.
posts.dek: We made two tools free — the ChatGPT Visibility Tracker and Prompt Pulse. A note on why seeing the problem shouldn't cost what fixing it does.
posts.leadParagraph: AI search is becoming the front door to your brand. Buyers ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews the questions they used to type into Google, and the answer comes back naming a short list of brands. The hard part isn't improving your spot in that answer — it's that most teams have no way to even see it.

body.text: When we sit down with marketing and brand teams, the first reaction is almost always the same: curiosity mixed with a little dread. They suspect AI engines are already shaping how buyers find them, but they can't tell whether ChatGPT recommends them, ignores them, or names a competitor. And when they go looking for the data, they hit a wall — the tools that can show them are priced for enterprises with five-figure budgets.

That bothered me. You shouldn't have to sign a five-figure contract to find out whether AI search is quietly routing your buyers to a competitor. Seeing the problem should be free. So we built two tools and gave them away.
The free ChatGPT Visibility Tracker

Enter your domain, and we run the high-intent prompts your buyers actually ask ChatGPT — then show you where you land: mentioned, cited, or skipped, and which competitor gets named in your place. No credit card, results in about five minutes. It answers one question honestly: when someone asks ChatGPT about your category, are you in the room?
Run the free ChatGPT Visibility Tracker
Prompt Pulse

The tracker tells you how you're doing on the prompts that matter. Prompt Pulse tells you which prompts matter. It's free AI-demand data: the real questions buyers ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, organized by industry, ranked by demand, and flagged for what's rising. We built it because "what should we even be tracking?" is the question that stalls most AEO programs before they start — and the answer was buried inside enterprise data products. Now it's a page you can read for free, updated monthly.
Explore Prompt Pulse
Why we made them free

Here's the conviction behind both. We don't think you should pay to see the problem. You should pay — if you choose to — to fix it. The diagnosis (where do I stand, what is my market actually asking AI) should be open. The execution — turning those gaps into governed, on-brand content and citations your team can approve, ship, and verify — is the hard, ongoing work, and that's what SolCrys charges for.

There's a selfish reason too, and I'd rather be honest about it. We're a young company in a category that's still being defined. The more brands that can see what's happening to them in AI search, the faster the whole category grows up — and the better the conversations we get to have. Free tools are how we earn the right to those conversations. We would rather be the team that helped you see clearly than the one that hid the mirror behind a sales call.

We also run both tools on ourselves, constantly. Like most brands new to AI search, we have our own gaps to close — and using the same instruments we hand to customers keeps us honest about what actually moves an answer.
Try them

Run the tracker on your domain, then open Prompt Pulse for your industry. If what you see makes you want to do something about it, that's what the rest of SolCrys is for. And if it just makes the shift to AI search a little less of a black box, that's a good outcome too.

posts.title: Introducing SolCrys AEO — the operating platform for brands to win AI search
posts.metaTitle: Introducing SolCrys AEO | A note from the founders
posts.description: Today we're launching SolCrys AEO — the operating platform for brands to measure, diagnose, fix, and verify their visibility across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overview, Gemini, and the rest of the AI answer layer.
posts.dek: Today we're launching SolCrys AEO. Measure visibility. Diagnose gaps. Activate the right actions. Verify what moved. All across leading answer engines, from one workspace governed by your brand.
posts.leadParagraph: Brand discovery is expanding beyond traditional search engines into AI search engines. Buyers now ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overview the questions they once typed into Google.

body.text: For marketing teams, the impact is immediate. CMOs are building AEO strategy. SEO teams have added AEO to their scope. Campaign teams want their sponsored thought-leadership articles to surface in AI engines.

But moving fast is hard. Teams are already using AI tools to draft content, SEO platforms to track rankings, and social listening tools to measure share of voice. None of these were built for AEO — and rolling out another tool across SEO, PMM, PR, brand, and communications can become a project of its own.
What teams want is simpler: one place to measure their brand across every AI answer engine, find the fixes that move the needle, and ship brand-consistent content.
Introducing SolCrys AEO

Today we're launching SolCrys AEO — the operating platform for brands to win AI search. Measure visibility. Diagnose gaps. Activate the right actions. Verify impact. All across leading answer engines, from one workspace governed by your brand tone and voice.
Industry-leading engine coverage
SolCrys covers the engines that matter most today: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overview, and Gemini. Additional engines, including shopping and retail, are available through selected plans.
Brand-safe and managed

SolCrys is fully managed. No infrastructure to stand up and maintain. The Corporate Context Layer keeps your messaging framework, brand writing guide, and approved claims governed and secured — forming the operating boundaries for every action SolCrys recommends.
One tool for every team and product line

Whether you're a lean team or a multi-product enterprise, SolCrys adapts to how your organization works. For smaller organizations, SolCrys brings the full AEO workflow into one focused workspace — so teams can move faster without adding operational complexity. For larger organizations, dedicated workspaces can be created by product line or function — each grounded in its own messaging, claims, and product truth.
Seamless workflow integration

SolCrys is built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) — the open standard for connecting AI systems to the tools you already use. That means SolCrys plugs into your marketing stack natively: content management systems, AI writing and coding tools such as Claude Cowork, ChatGPT, and Codex. As more systems expose MCP servers, new integrations come online without custom integration work.
Product deep dive
SolCrys AEO brings the full AEO workflow into one platform — from tracking visibility to finding gaps, shipping fixes, and proving impact.
Track the prompts that matter

You can't defend what you can't measure. SolCrys shows where your brand stands across leading answer engines — from mention rate and share of voice to citations and sentiment — tied to the prompts that matter most. Brand, PR, PMM, and campaign teams get one clear view your CMO can take to the board.
Find the gaps and ship the fixes

See which prompts your brand wins and where it's lagging. SolCrys identifies the top domains driving answers, shows where your brand is mentioned and why, then recommends actions to move the needle — from a content update or UGC strategy to a PR angle. Run content audits and manage the work in a kanban view with owners and status tracked across teams.
Verify what moved

After each action ships, re-run the same prompt set to measure what changed. SolCrys tracks citation rate, AI answer accuracy, recommendation share, and visibility movement, so teams can see which fixes improved the answer and which gaps still need work. Every result ties back to the original prompt, citation, and action — giving teams a clear way to prove impact.
Try it today

The fastest way to see how AI engines are talking about your brand is to run a free audit. We'll surface where you're already winning, where you're invisible, and which fixes will move the needle first.
Start your free audit

If you'd rather start with the methodology, our resource library covers AEO fundamentals, per-engine optimization playbooks, and the buyer guides we publish for marketing teams evaluating this category.

posts.title: SolCrys Names Raejeanne Skillern, Former AWS CMO and Intel Leader, as Strategic Advisor
posts.metaTitle: SolCrys Names Raejeanne Skillern as Strategic Advisor | SolCrys News
posts.description: Veteran tech executive Raejeanne Skillern, former AWS CMO and longtime Intel data center leader, joins SolCrys as a strategic advisor as the company builds the AEO operating system for brands in AI search.
posts.dek: Veteran tech executive joins SolCrys to help brands get discovered and recommended in AI search.

heroImage.name: Raejeanne Skillern
heroImage.alt: Portrait of Raejeanne Skillern, Strategic Advisor at SolCrys

posts.leadParagraph: SolCrys, the AEO operating system for brands to win discovery in AI, today announced that Raejeanne Skillern — former Chief Marketing Officer at Amazon Web Services and a longtime hyperscale infrastructure leader — has joined the company as a strategic advisor.

body.text: Skillern brings more than 30 years of leadership across cloud, data center infrastructure, communications, and artificial intelligence. She has led multi-billion-dollar businesses at AWS, Intel, and Flex. Skillern currently serves on the boards of Jabil (NYSE: JBL) and Dycom Industries (NYSE: DY).

Raejeanne brings a rare combination of operating experience, market insight, and board-level perspective at a moment when AI is reshaping how companies build and grow their brands. As organizations across industries adapt to AI-driven discovery and decision-making, her experience scaling global businesses and guiding technology transformation will be invaluable to SolCrys and the customers we serve.

At AWS, Skillern led the global marketing organization, helping to modernize marketing for AI. At Flex, she ran a multi-billion P&L as President of the Communications, Enterprise & Cloud Division, repositioning the business for cloud, optical, and 5G. Over 25 years at Intel, she built the hyperscale data center business alongside the world's leading cloud providers.

AI answer engines are changing how customers discover, evaluate, and choose companies, but most organizations are not yet equipped to manage their presence in this new environment. SolCrys gives companies a clear way to measure how they appear across AI platforms, identify what needs improvement, strengthen their visibility, and track results — while staying true to their brand. SolCrys is building the category-defining platform for how companies manage brand visibility and trust in the AI era.
About SolCrys

SolCrys was founded by a team of AI, data, search, marketing, and growth veterans from Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Alibaba, and Tencent, building the AEO operating system for the next era of brand discovery. The company today serves brands across HPC, AI, consumer goods, retail, and beyond.

posts.title: Welcoming Raejeanne Skillern to SolCrys
posts.metaTitle: Welcoming Raejeanne Skillern to SolCrys | Founder Note
posts.description: A note from SolCrys CEO Gwen Chen on why Raejeanne Skillern — former AWS CMO and longtime Intel hyperscale leader — is joining SolCrys as a strategic advisor, and what it signals about where the company is headed.
posts.dek: A note from our founder on why Raejeanne is joining — and what it signals about where the AEO category, and SolCrys, are headed.

heroImage.name: Raejeanne Skillern
heroImage.alt: Raejeanne Skillern, newly joined SolCrys strategic advisor

posts.leadParagraph: When we started SolCrys, we made a bet that AI answer engines would fundamentally change how customers discover, evaluate, and choose brands — and that most marketing teams weren't equipped for that shift yet.

body.text: Nine months in, that bet is no longer speculative. Buyers are starting product research in ChatGPT instead of Google. Shoppers are getting recommendations from Amazon Rufus and Walmart Sparky before they see a listing. Google AI Mode is changing search from a list of links into AI-generated answers that increasingly shape how customers discover brands. The companies winning are the ones treating AI visibility as something they can measure, diagnose, fix, and prove — not a black box.
That is the operating system we are building at SolCrys. And today, I'm thrilled to share that Raejeanne Skillern is joining us as a strategic advisor.
Why Raejeanne, and why now

Raejeanne spent more than 30 years inside the buildout of modern cloud infrastructure — at Intel, where she built the hyperscale data center business alongside AWS, Azure, and Google; at Flex, where she ran a multi-billion-dollar P&L for cloud, optical, and 5G; and most recently as CMO at AWS, where she led marketing through the early phase of the generative AI shift.

She has seen, more than almost anyone in the industry, how an inflection point in infrastructure rewrites how every category gets sold. That perspective is exactly what we need right now, for three main reasons.
1. She understands what changes when a category moves from search-led to recommendation-led discovery.

The buyer journey for cloud compute did not simply change — the entire vendor evaluation framework changed. The same shift is now happening for consumer brands, B2B software, retail SKUs, and professional services inside the AI answer layer. Most of our customers are still operating with SEO-era playbooks. Raejeanne has lived through this kind of transition before, and she can help us help them.
2. She has scaled marketing organizations that operate as one team alongside product and sales.

Answer Engine Optimization is not just an SEO-team problem. It requires collaboration across SEO, PMM, brand, communications, PR, product, and sales. SolCrys is built to be the connective tissue between these teams, and Raejeanne has built the operating models that make this kind of cross-functional execution work at scale.
3. She brings board-level perspective at exactly the right time for SolCrys.

Raejeanne sits on the boards of Jabil (NYSE: JBL) and Dycom Industries (NYSE: DY). The questions boards are now asking about AI exposure — what is our visibility, where are we losing share, is this measured — are exactly the questions SolCrys is built to answer. Having someone on the team who thinks about technology adoption from both sides of the boardroom table sharpens how we build, what we prioritize, and how we define the category.
What this signals for the brands we serve
If you're a customer, advisor, partner, or prospect reading this: Raejeanne's involvement is a signal of where we're investing. Over the next two quarters we are doubling down on three things.

items: Cross-engine measurement depth — moving beyond mention and citation counting to true Share of Recommendation and answer-accuracy tracking, prompt-by-prompt, across ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews / AI Mode, Perplexity, Amazon Rufus, Walmart Sparky, and ChatGPT Shopping.

Corporate Context as the brand operating layer — ensuring every action SolCrys recommends is grounded in your approved stats, claims, and guardrails by default, so your content stays on-brand, accurate, and defensible.

The execution loop — closing the gap between 'we found the gap' and 'we fixed it', with draft briefs to media outlets, analysts and influencers, FAQ updates, and content actions tied to measurable movements in AI answers.

body.text: Closing

I started SolCrys with my co-founders Eason and Jia because we believed brand discovery was about to be rewritten, and the teams building inside that change deserved a real operating system, not another dashboard.
Bringing Raejeanne onto the team will help us better serve our customers as they navigate this next phase of AI discovery.
Welcome, Raejeanne. We're thrilled to have you with us.
